title: Physics & Slopes
description: Configure capsule colliders, angled ramps, slope alignment, and solid terrain so characters climb hills and cross tile seams smoothly.

blocks.content: Sharp rectangular colliders can snag on tile boundaries or get stuck at the base of angled ramps. By combining capsule corner rounding on [Multi-Collider](components/multi_collider), sloped vector geometry on [Shape Renderer](components/renderers/shape_renderer), and slope alignment on [Physics Body](components/physics_body), you get smooth traversal across flat tiles and hills.

items.title: Capsule Feet
items.desc: Round collider corners with **Corner Radius (Capsule)** to glide across tilemap seams and ramp transitions.

items.title: Polygon Ramps
items.desc: Draw angled terrain in **Shape Renderer** and enable **Solid** physics in one click.

items.title: Slope Alignment
items.desc: Tilt character sprites to match hill angles automatically with **Align to Slope**.

items.title: Upright Collider Lock
items.desc: Keep the physical collision box vertical with **Lock World Rotation (Stay Upright)**.

blocks.content: You need a character [entity](components/entities_and_prefabs) and a sloped ground entity in the same **World** layer.

rows: Character Entity

[Physics Body](components/physics_body) (**Dynamic**), [Multi-Collider](components/multi_collider) (**Solid (Physics)**), and a movement controller such as [Platformer Movement](behaviour/movement/platformer).
Slope / Ramp Entity
[Shape Renderer](components/renderers/shape_renderer) with a closed **Polygon** ramp and **Solid** enabled in its **Physics** settings (or a rotated **Solid (Physics)** box collider).

blocks.content: Follow these steps to build a sloped ramp and configure your character to climb it smoothly.

items: Create a ramp entity in your **World** layer, attach a [Shape Renderer](components/renderers/shape_renderer), and click **Edit Shape** in the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector).
Press **G** to select the **Polygon** tool, draw a triangular or sloped ramp, and press **Enter** to commit the shape.
In the **Shape Renderer** section of the **Property Inspector**, check **Solid** under **Physics**.
Select your character entity, open its **Collider** section, and increase **Corner Radius (Capsule)** to half of the collider's width so the bottom forms a smooth capsule.
Still in the character's **Collider** section, check **Lock World Rotation (Stay Upright)** so the physical collider never tips into the ramp.
In the character's **Physics Body** section, check **Align to Slope**, set **Max Slope (deg)** to **60**, and click **Play** in the [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport).

blocks.content: Tune these properties across **Physics Body** and **Collider** to control how the character handles ramps and terrain.

rows: Corner Radius (Capsule) (Collider)
8 to 16 (half of width)
Rounds the collider corners so the character slides smoothly onto slopes and over [Tilemap](components/renderers/tilemap) seams.
Lock World Rotation (Stay Upright) (Collider)
Checked (true)
Keeps the solid collision bounds vertical in world space while the entity's visual sprite rotates to match the slope.
Align to Slope (Physics Body)
Checked (true)
Rotates the entity to match the surface normal of the ground beneath it.
Adapt Speed (Physics Body)
Controls how quickly the entity's rotation interpolates when entering or leaving a slope.
Max Slope (deg) (Physics Body)
Maximum incline in degrees (5 to 89) that the character can walk up without sliding back down.
Gravity Scale (Physics Body)
Keeps the character grounded firmly when cresting the top of a ramp.

blocks.content: Use runtime physics and collision nodes from [Physics & Collision](node_library/game_physics) to adapt behavior on different surfaces.

rows: One-Way Slopes or Bridges
Assign the **platform** tag to a bridge entity and match **oneWayTag** on [Platformer Controller](node_library/helper_tool#node-platformerController) so players can jump up through it or drop down.
Ice or Mud Surfaces

Detect surface tags with [Solid Collision](node_library/game_physics#node-solidCollision) and adjust **drag** or **velocityX** at runtime using [Set Physics Info](node_library/game_physics#node-setPhysics).
Ground & Ledge Raycasting
Use [Raycast 2D](node_library/game_physics#node-raycast2D) pointing downward ahead of an enemy to detect ledges or steep drops before stepping forward.
Character snags or stutters at the bottom of a ramp
Increase **Corner Radius (Capsule)** on the character's **Solid (Physics)** collider so a sharp box corner does not catch on the ramp edge.
Character sprite tilts on a slope and gets wedged into the floor
Check **Lock World Rotation (Stay Upright)** in the character's **Collider** section.
Character cannot climb a steep ramp
Increase **Max Slope (deg)** in **Physics Body** so it exceeds the angle of your ramp.
